name: io.github.cyanheads/wakeonlan-mcp-server
description: Wake LAN machines with Wake-on-LAN magic packets from host profiles, then confirm they came up.

environmentVariables.name: WOL_HOSTS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the JSON hosts file (a leading ~/ expands to the home directory). Mutually exclusive with WOL_HOSTS.

environmentVariables.name: WOL_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: The hosts document as inline JSON, for single-host setups. Mutually exclusive with WOL_HOSTS_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode to use: 'none', 'jwt', or 'oauth'. The server refuses to start without jwt or oauth when MCP_HTTP_HOST is not a loopback address or MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is '*'.

environmentVariables.name: WOL_HOSTS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the JSON hosts file (a leading ~/ expands to the home directory). Mutually exclusive with WOL_HOSTS.

environmentVariables.name: WOL_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: The hosts document as inline JSON, for single-host setups. Mutually exclusive with WOL_HOSTS_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
